title: Kecksburg crash and Eric Walker connection
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Kecksburg crash and Eric Walker connection, about 1965 at Kecksburg, Pennsylvania, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I would say Kexsburg with the Eric Walker, you know, connection I think is really fascinating.
I think Eric Walker was also supposedly present at the Cexsburg accident.
tellings.difference: Says Walker was 'supposedly' present at the crash and ties him to MJ-12.
tellings.link_reason: Both link Eric Walker to the 1965 Kecksburg crash.

as_told.title: Eric Walker at Kecksburg and MJ-12

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says he finds the 1965 crash at Kecksburg, a small town in Pennsylvania where something is said to have come down, especially fascinating because of a man named Eric Walker. In another telling Michels says Walker was supposedly present at the crash and ties him to Majestic 12, a supposed secret group of officials said to handle UFO matters. If true, it would link the crash to that hidden group.
